title: axross built-in catalog
description: Images from Docker's curated mcp/* namespace on Docker Hub, pinned by digest. Each digest was read from the Docker Hub API and the registry's manifest on 2026-10-25, and each server was started under axross's container flags (initialize, tools/list, one call).

entries.name: git
entries.title: Git (Reference)
entries.description: Git repository interaction: status, diff, log, show, add, commit, branches. The chosen repository is mounted at /repo; tools take repo_path "/repo". Read-only unless write is allowed.

mounts.description: The git repository the server works on

entries.name: filesystem
entries.title: Filesystem (Reference)
entries.description: Read, search and (with write allowed) change files in the chosen folders only. Each folder appears as /projects/<folder name>.

mounts.description: A folder the server may reach

entries.name: fetch
entries.title: Fetch (Reference)
entries.description: Fetches a URL from the internet and extracts its contents as markdown. Needs network: Full, or Allowlist with the hosts it may fetch from.
entries.license: MIT (upstream src/fetch; Docker Hub states Other)

entries.name: sqlite
entries.title: SQLite (Reference)
entries.description: Queries and changes an SQLite database. By default the database lives in the container's /tmp and is gone when the server stops; to keep it, mount a folder at /data, allow write and set the argument to --db-path /data/db.sqlite.

mounts.description: A folder for a database that is kept

entries.name: memory
entries.title: Memory (Reference)
entries.description: A knowledge graph the model can write to and read back: entities, relations, observations. By default it lives in the container's /tmp; to keep it, mount a folder at /data, allow write and set MEMORY_FILE_PATH to /data/memory.json.

env.name: MEMORY_FILE_PATH
env.description: Where the graph is stored inside the container

mounts.description: A folder for a graph that is kept

entries.name: sequentialthinking
entries.title: Sequential Thinking (Reference)
entries.description: Step-by-step, revisable problem solving through a sequence of thoughts.

entries.name: time
entries.title: Time (Reference)
entries.description: The current time in a time zone and conversion between time zones.

entries.name: everything
entries.title: Everything (Reference test server)
entries.description: The MCP test server: echo, add, environment, long-running operations, images and resources - for trying a client, not for work.

entries.name: vuln-nist
entries.title: Vuln NIST (NVD / CVE lookups)
entries.description: Queries NIST's National Vulnerability Database: CVEs by id, keyword or CPE, CISA KEV entries, CVE change history. No API key needed. Needs network to services.nvd.nist.gov.

entries.name: shodan
entries.title: Shodan (Cyreslab)
entries.description: Shodan host, service, SSL and IoT search. Needs a Shodan API key (kept in the keyring) and network to api.shodan.io.
